svg.title: The rangeland nearest the viewer in late summer: rough fescue in tufts with dry straw seed heads and yellow gumweed, scattered fieldstones, the grass under the horse trail the ride's strip runs over, and taller, darker grass below it. A repeating strip over the ground fill (ADR-0042), world y 1280..1920; local y 0 is the level ground line. GENERIC BY CONSTRUCTION: no fence, gate, building or animal.
